title: LMOT Knowledge Unit Schema
description: Schema for Knowledge Units in the LMOT Knowledge Matrix. Used by MCP servers and AI agents to parse and validate unit metadata.

unit_id.description: Unique identifier following the format: DOMAIN-TOPIC-NUMBER (e.g., TECH-ESP-001)

title.description: Human-readable title of the Knowledge Unit

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the unit

updated.description: Last update date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)

author.description: Author or organization responsible for the unit

tags.description: Searchable keywords for discovery and categorization

dependencies.description: List of unit_ids that this unit depends on or references
